summary: Phase 9 part 4: the library's finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibria are Mercier-unstable (family 1 proved on every surface; family 2 numerically, conditional theorem), so they are not MHD-stable stellarator candidates. Earlier: KAM inputs complete for an approximate invariant torus of the exact stellarator field; coil-produced confinement for one transit; one consistent axisymmetric plasma with certified local stability up to ignition.

tasks.model-contracts:I2: Lean verified — uniform-field and nonzero-current force-free witnesses in the Cartesian slab model; not toroidal confinement.

tasks.implementation-plan:M0: Lean verified — exact slab, screw-pinch, Solov'ev and helical equilibria with kernel force balance, all-time field-line/orbit confinement, Suydam both ways and screw-pinch Newcomb for 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 (idealized symmetric models).

tasks.implementation-plan:M4: Partially implemented — passing 3.5 MeV alphas in reactor-scale near-axis QA stay inside for 0.19 s (≈ half the slowing-down time; Boozer GC model); trapped alphas: single well and non-resonant bounce-sum lemmas, kick form assumed.
tasks.implementation-plan:M5: Partially implemented — exact rational vacuum stellarator field with ≥ 95-transit certified confinement; a concrete coil-produced field (closed polygonal filaments + TF filament) with certified confinement for one toroidal transit (zero margin); validated approximate invariant torus and KAM lemmas toward all-time confinement.
